label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP headers flows through param -> StringBuilder -> HashMap retrieval -> substring -> Base64 encode/decode -> split, then combines with static strings and cookie metadata in response.getWriter().println() calls. While transformations occur, the final output concatenates user-derived values (via rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue()) directly into HTML response without proper encoding/escaping, creating XSS exposure.

evidence.note: Cookie name and value derived from user input concatenated into HTML response without escaping
